name: Ethel Rethor
summary: Along Desolace's northwestern coast, Ethel Rethor's drowned halls lie beneath the sea. A sealed tower rises above the waves, while naga hold the sunken settlement.

sections.title: A Drowned Relic
sections.body: Ethel Rethor's broken stones line the coast of western Kalimdor. Before the Great Sundering, a night elven settlement stood here, but much of it has since fallen beneath the sea. Shattered foundations lie under the waves, and one weathered tower rises from the surf. A small bridge reaches its sealed portal, still closed against the elements and intruders. Naga now hold the drowned chambers and nearby shallows, making these waters dangerous to approach.

sections.title: Watchers on the Shore
sections.body: Travelers come to Ethel Rethor to study Kalimdor's forgotten history and watch its dangers today. Near the ruins, Azore Aldamort serves the Argent Dawn. He watches the naga and offers aid to those willing to dive into the sunken passages. The waters offshore are dangerous, and barren wastes stretch inland. So the ruins remain a lonely meeting place on the coast.

faq.answer: Ethel Rethor's ruined night elven settlement lies on Desolace's northwestern coast. Most of its former structures have sunk beneath the sea, leaving a solitary tower offshore and drowned stonework.
Naga occupy Ethel Rethor's sunken ruins and nearby reefs. They have claimed the drowned halls and patrol the surrounding shallows aggressively.

faq.q: Can you go inside the tower?
faq.answer: A small bridge leads to the tower's entrance, but the doorway is sealed shut. Travelers can explore its exterior and dive into the ruins beneath it.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn here?
faq.answer: Azore Aldamort, an Argent Dawn representative, keeps watch near Ethel Rethor. Though the Dawn focuses on the Scourge in the east, its agents across Kalimdor monitor unusual magical disturbances, ancient ruins, and threats such as the naga.

angles.text: For night elves, Ethel Rethor is a somber monument to their lost empire and the cataclysmic Sundering. Mutated brethren now prowl its sunken halls.
As an Alliance traveler crossing Desolace's hostile barrens, you can find a rare friendly face near the ruins: Azore Aldamort, an Argent Dawn observer.
